# Update the run method to fix both issues
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
content = result.stdout

# Find and replace the relevant section
old_section = '''                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(unescape(text), self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        name = striptags(raw_label)
                    else:
                        name = text
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name
                    })'''

new_section = '''                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Unescape HTML entities and markdown escape sequences before slugifying
                    slug_text = html.unescape(unescape(text))
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(slug_text, self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        name = striptags(raw_label)
                    else:
                        name = striptags(text)
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name
                    })'''

new_content = content.replace(old_section, new_section)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("Updated run method")

# Verify
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['sed', '-n', '340,370p', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result2.stdout)
